metadata.title: OpenTUI runtime preflight successor with executable verification

work.objective: Reproduce and independently verify the rejected R1 OpenTUI runtime preflight: unsupported Node runtimes must fail before native renderer import with an actionable Bun command, while Bun passes a real native FFI probe.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for all reads, edits, searches and commands.
Only modify the allowed UI dispatch/runtime files; do not change OpenTUI product components, dependencies, lockfiles, Ink behavior, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
Do not import or copy files from the rejected Marshal worktree; independently implement from the branch base and the frozen requirements.
Do not claim Node 24 support: the locked @opentui/core 0.5.1 requires Bun or a Node runtime that can actually load node:ffi.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: R1 was rejected solely because its frozen ./node_modules/.bin/vitest acceptance executable remained unresolved in two independent verification rounds; its code was not integrated or accepted.
A real user reproduced Node v24.15.0 failing deep inside @opentui/core, while QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui bun packages/cli/dist/index.js renders successfully.
Gate before importing the native-dependent OpenTUI renderer. Unsupported runtimes exit nonzero with the verified Bun command; default Ink remains unchanged.
Use a fail-closed node:ffi loadability probe rather than a version-only guess. Add focused tests and retain the real Bun resolveRenderLib gate.
nonGoals: No visual parity or Solid work
